10.1038/s41467-026-68637-4.name: IFUM
10.1038/s41467-026-68637-4.input: Protein sequence and a folded structure; no unfolded structure is supplied.
10.1038/s41467-026-68637-4.target: Absolute unfolding ΔG; differences between variants give ΔΔG, including insertions/deletions.
10.1038/s41467-026-68637-4.training: Mega-scale proteins and disordered proteins; natural-protein data are also used for fine-tuning.
10.1038/s41467-026-68637-4.benchmarks: Held-out Mega-scale; Mega-scale Common; natural, engineered, and designed proteins.

10.1073/pnas.2314853121.name: ThermoMPNN
10.1073/pnas.2314853121.input: Wild-type protein structure and sequence, plus a proposed substitution.
10.1073/pnas.2314853121.training: Transfer learning from ProteinMPNN, with experimental Mega-scale stability data.
10.1073/pnas.2314853121.benchmarks: Held-out Mega-scale; homology-filtered FireProt; S669; Ssym; protein case studies.

10.7554/eLife.82593.name: RaSP
10.7554/eLife.82593.input: A wild-type atomic structure and a proposed amino-acid substitution.
10.7554/eLife.82593.training: A 3D-CNN representation model followed by a network trained on Rosetta-derived ΔΔG.
10.7554/eLife.82593.benchmarks: Rosetta-held-out proteins; experimental stability measurements; S669; Ssym+; Mega-scale.

10.1093/bioinformatics/btad671.name: PROSTATA
10.1093/bioinformatics/btad671.input: Wild-type and mutant protein sequences; a 3D structure is not required.
10.1093/bioinformatics/btad671.training: ESM-2 transfer learning with curated experimental stability data; an ensemble of five regression heads.
10.1093/bioinformatics/btad671.benchmarks: S669; Ssym and reverse mutations; protein case studies; natural and designed miniproteins.

10.1038/s41586-023-06328-6.name: Mega-scale dataset
10.1038/s41586-023-06328-6.input: Experimental cDNA-display proteolysis measurements on small protein variants.
10.1038/s41586-023-06328-6.target: Folding-stability measurements used to train and evaluate predictors.
10.1038/s41586-023-06328-6.training: Experimental dataset paper; not a predictor.
10.1038/s41586-023-06328-6.benchmarks: Natural and designed domains with large mutation libraries. Check the exact split used by each downstream model.
